notes.title: Patch Note v1.22
notes.content:
It's been a little bit since the last update but We've released a big new patch based on player feedback.
This includes some fixes for major bugs, saving game, and other things. Here are the full change log for v1.22:

[h1] Updates[/h1] 

The save/load system has been added.
Added In-game tooltips to help new players.
Added recipe button to assist in understanding how to craft.
Added Settings button in the menu page.
Some balance tweaks.
Major optimization related to map generation.
Added a new trap in goblin fortress.
Adjusted the game difficulty.
Added mark to the world map.

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

Fixed a bug that could not sometimes get into the cave.
Fixed a bug with achievements.
Fixed numerous other issues.
